competences.description: Attacks the enemy to remove 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance. This attack will deal more damage according to your Defense.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)

competences.description: Increases the Defense of all allies for 2 turns and goes under the Threat state while enemies attack with a single-target skill 2 times. Enemies excluding the boss can only attack the target under the Threat state when using an attack skill.

effets.description: The target's defense will be increased by 70%.

The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.

competences.description: Decreases the damage that all allies receive by up to 35% and increases the damage you deal to enemies by up to 100% in proportion to your Defense. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
